title: US Divorce Fell From 4.7 To 2.4 Per 1,000
hook: Divorce did not rise; it fell to 2.4 per 1,000.
closing: The famous divorce scare describes an America that no longer exists.
question: Did you think divorce was rising?

segments.say: US divorce fell from 4.7 per 1,000 in 1990 to 2.4 in 2022.
Women's first-marriage age rose from 23.9 in 1990 to 28.6 in 2024.
